# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (May 6, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing the `op-devstack` with a new Kona preset, improving `op-supernode` configurability and startup, and significant cleanup of SuperCannon game type support. Documentation for `contracts-bedrock` was also updated.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Interoperability and Supernode Enhancements
A new `MinimalWithKona` preset was added to `op-devstack` to facilitate native `kona-host` runs for acceptance tests, streamlining the testing of interoperability features [#20529](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20529). The `op-supernode` now supports configuring the interop log backfill depth via an environment variable, improving its flexibility [#20566](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20566). Additionally, the interop log backfill process was adjusted to run before SafeDB startup readiness, ensuring more robust node initialization [#20568](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20568).

### Dispute Monitoring and Challenger Refinements
Support for the plain SuperCannon (game type 4) was removed from both `op-challenger` [#20555](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20555) and `op-dispute-mon` [#20556](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20556), simplifying the codebase and focusing on current game types. The `op-interop-filter` gained optional reorg recovery support, enhancing its resilience to chain reorganizations [#20554](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20554).

### Rust Tooling and Infrastructure Updates
The `op-alloy` and `alloy-op-hardforks` Rust crates were released in new versions (2.0 and 0.5.0 respectively) [#20325](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20325). A new release recipe was added to the Rust `justfile` to streamline the publishing of subdirectory crates and their dependencies [#20320](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20320). Dead code related to `InteropValidator` and `InteropValidationError` was removed from the `kona-interop` protocol [#20567](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20567).

### Documentation and Dependency Updates
The `contracts-bedrock` style guide was updated with a note on Foundry's intrinsic gas behavior in tests, providing clearer guidance for developers [#20570](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20570). The `op-geth` dependency was upgraded across the project [#20564](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20564).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- **Feature Development:**
    - [#20581](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20581) `feat(op-node): serve superroot_atTimestamp for non-interop chains`
    - [#20576](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20576) `feat(kona-proof): cache L1 block-number lookups in OracleL1ChainProvider`
    - [#20577](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20577) `op-supernode: default log backfill to 7 days`
    - [#20559](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20559) `op-supernode: serve full superroot RPC from durable state post-activation`
    - [#20558](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20558) `op-supernode: store verified superroot records`
    - [#20557](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20557) `op-interop-filter: expose latest cross-unsafe block`
- **Bug Fixes:**
    - [#20580](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20580) `fix(op-acceptance-tests): drain LocalSafe in freezeChains`
    - [#20579](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20579) `fix(kona-interop): init-chain activation gate`
    - [#20575](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20575) `fix(op-devstack): add WithoutHonestProposer preset option for challenger tests`
    - [#20571](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20571) `fix: update each system config to have the same weth on migrate`
    - [#20560](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20560) `fix(kona/protocol): iterate all payload txs in is_deposits_only`
- **Other Improvements:**
    - [#20572](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20572) `[experiment] contracts-bedrock: enable foundry isolate=true by default`
    - [#20569](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20569) `op-supernode: filter inactive interop backfill logs`
    - [#20565](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20565) `test(contracts): stage past NUT bundles in L2 fork upgrades`
    - [#20561](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20561) `Add supernode explainer`

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Interoperability Monitoring and AutoStop Implementation
Several issues related to interoperability monitoring and the AutoStop feature have been closed. This includes integrating the monitor service with infrastructure [#16228](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/16228), implementing AutoStop for the supervisor and node [#16230](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/16230), creating a runbook and script for AutoStop [#16231](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/16231), and integrating AutoStop with the monitoring service [#16232](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/16232). Additionally, monitoring for AccessList violations in `op-interop-mon` has been addressed [#16510](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/16510).

### `op-supernode` Healthcheck and Interop Testing
The issue concerning `op-supernode` charts supporting healthchecks on `/<chain-id>/` subdomains has been resolved [#18451](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18451). Integration testing with Interop for `op-supernode` has also been completed [#18756](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18756).

### Geth Disk Usage and Proxyd Deployment
A problem with rapid disk usage in Geth after State Snapshot Generation has been closed [#15452](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/15452). The deployment of Proxyd-CL Prod-Mainnet to serve Light nodes was also completed and closed [#20573](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20573).

## NEW ISSUES

### Superchain Operations and Upgrade Support
New issues highlight the need for `superchain-ops` to support upgrading chains from permissioned to permissionless [#20562](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20562) and to add overrides for the `SuperchainRegistry` contract for devnets during upgrades [#20563](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20563).

### Testing and Interoperability Challenges
A flaky test, `TestChallengerRespondsToMultipleInvalidClaims`, has been reported [#20574](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20574). Another issue points out that the Kona init-chain interop activation gate is disabled when `interop_time` is `None` [#20578](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20578).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Flaky Test: `TestPreinteropFaultProofs_VariedBlockTimes` [#19804](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19804)
This test continues to be flaky. A fix was submitted in #19805, addressing a root cause where `l1BlockWithLocalSafeBlocks()` polling led to races. However, the test flaked again with a different root cause. The latest comment from @ajsutton indicates that `freezeChains` was not properly draining `LocalSafe` up to `LocalUnsafe` before stopping batchers, leading to `startTimestamp` being less than the unsafe head time of the faster chain. A fix has been opened in #20580 to reorder `freezeChains` to ensure `LocalSafe == LocalUnsafe` before proceeding.
